name: The Seventh Seal
storyline:
Violet’s world doesn’t end.

It is exposed.

What begins as her familiar apartment slowly fractures as the Devil forces her to see reality as it truly is. Safety is stripped away. Prison bars tear through doorframes. Blood stains seep into walls. The building reveals itself as a corrupted reflection of the world she once knew.

When Violet opens a door inside her bathroom, she crosses into a twisted backworld—an ever-shifting maze of horror where familiar places rot into nightmares. Apartments collapse into dim hospital corridors lined with broken lights and steel gurneys stacked with corpses. Children’s daycare rooms reappear as desecrated spaces filled with death and cruelty. Every room reshapes itself as she moves through it, haunted by the echoes of past violence and suffering.

Violet is not meant to overpower what hunts her.

The undead that stalk these hallways are nearly impervious to physical damage. Survival depends on stealth, timing, and the environment itself. Massive mechanical traps—spike walls, crushing mechanisms, swinging death machines—fill the corridors, designed to kill anything caught within them. Violet must lure her pursuers into these traps, turning the building’s cruelty against its inhabitants.

Throughout her descent, the Dark One watches.
He mocks her fear.
Whispers temptation.
Attempts to wear her down and claim her body and will.

By the end of the demo, Violet is drawn into a vast, ruined cathedral. A sermon is already underway, his disciples kneeling in worship beneath towering shadows. She is offered a final choice: drink his blood, merge with him, and become part of the end he is shaping.

Violet refuses.

In that moment, she ceases to be prey and becomes an enemy.

The Seventh Seal is a survival-horror experience focused on vulnerability, psychological torment, and environmental mastery. It is not about escaping the end of days—but resisting it, even when resistance feels hopeless.

The world has already fallen.

The Devil is waiting.

And Violet has chosen to stand against him.
summary: The Seventh Seal is a story-driven supernatural horror game about survival at the end of days. Trapped inside a sealed apartment complex as the world collapses, Violet must navigate haunting corridors, solve deadly environmental puzzles, and outsmart malicious spirits using the very traps meant to kill her. With an emphasis on vulnerability, fear, and demonic horror, The Seventh Seal is built for players who crave tension, dread, and survival through wit—not firepower.
